chapters.prose_result: THE TESTER shipped. Indoor tray task succeeds; sustained wear reveals early upper-lateral heat that Greg reports before injury. After adjustment, Masta authorizes a short controlled exterior route. Cambered paving accelerates right-step shortening/outward compensation; she turns Greg back before planned post. No take-home limb. Next session in three days.
chapters.character_surprise: Greg values early heat reporting and accepts Masta canceling the arbitrary post target when new information appears.
chapters.protagonist_gravity: Reduced: terrain and Masta's interpretation control progression; Venn carries crutches as backup rather than participating in a symbolic abandonment ritual.
chapters.memory_helped: Yes. Restraint-as-competence and usable-hands priority continue to govern progression.
